description: Permanent aircraft monument at Dataran Pahlawan Negara in Presint 1, Putrajaya. Selected from the retired RMAF MiG-29N fleet at Kuantan; an asset inspection by the Prime Minister's Department and Perbadanan Putrajaya took place at No. 17 Squadron's shelter at Kuantan Air Base on 22 August 2023 and the aircraft was released to the monument project. This is the second RMAF Fulcrum turned into a monument, after M43-06 at the Joint Force Headquarters near Kuantan. Installation on site is reported but not confirmed by a dated photograph, so the display status should be re-checked.
